method.koWinDefinition: Winner has possession at the final whistle AND all five opponents have 0 HP. No automatic KO victory exists.
method.description: Current AI on both sides. Every ordered opening combination gets the same number of games. Cross-opening scenarios share a seed with their side-swapped counterpart; self-opening scenarios use distinct seeds and are never duplicated. No career progression. Jeu libre has no imposed opening and is excluded.
